title: Platinum Rewards Card: Rebate Eligibility and Calcluation
summary: This document explains Platinum Rewards Card eligibility for an annual fee rebate: you must meet the required monthly spending threshold in every month of your 12 consecutive monthly windows (no partial/prorated rebate). It defines the monthly posting-date calculation window, what counts/excludes (e.g., net purchases incl. authorized users and virtual cards; excludes fees/interest, cash advances, balance transfers), and when the rebate is assessed and posted as a statement credit (after the annual fee is billed), with forfeiture if the account is closed/product-changed before evaluation/posting.
faqs: How do I qualify for the Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate?
What happens if I miss the monthly spending threshold in just one month?
When are transactions counted for the monthly threshold—authorization date or posting date?
What purchases count toward the monthly threshold (authorized users, virtual cards, international purchases)?
What transactions are excluded from the monthly threshold (fees/interest, cash advances, balance transfers, disputes)?
When is the rebate evaluated and posted, and can it be denied if my account is closed or product-changed?
keywords: statement credit after annual fee billed
excluded: cash advances, balance transfers, cash-equivalent transactions
